newsitem.title: USA: Lamar Advertising completes purchase, sale.
newsitem.headline: Lamar Advertising completes purchase, sale.

text.p: Lamar Advertising Co on Tuesday said it completed its $76.6 million cash acquisition of Headrick Outdoor Inc and its sale of 1,400 advertising displays to Universal Outdoor Inc for $46.5 million in cash.
Lamar said in a statement that the Headrick purchase included 3,600 bulletin displays in 10 states. Lamar sold 330 of the acquired displays for $6 million.
The sale to Universal Outdoor included 1,400 displays in Baltimore that Lamar acquired in April.
Lamar also said it acquired the stock of McWhorter Advertising Inc for $8.5 million in cash.
